notes.title: Patch 1.1 – New Features and Improvements
notes.content: [p]The version 1.1 of the [i]Heart of Gaia[/i] DEMO brings the following changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]New boss added[/b]: Face a new challenge and test your combat skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New area[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional scenes[/b]: Discover more of the game's story with new scenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebalancing of early enemies[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Goblin[/p][/*][*][p]Goblin Archer[/p][/*][*][p]Hobgoblin[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b]: Various adjustments to improve the gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Get ready for new adventures and refined combat![/p]

notes.title: Heart of Gaia Demo Now Available!
notes.content: [p]The demo for [b]Heart of Gaia[/b], our new Action RPG, is now available to play directly on Steam. This version introduces the beginning of the adventure and offers [b]over an hour of content[/b] for you to explore.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630128/84ed7bdace767639a50f1badde12b997bdef124a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What you'll find in the demo:[/b][/p][list][*][p]An engaging introduction to the main story[/p][/*][*][p][b]6 side quests[/b] with unique rewards[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 challenging boss battles[/b] to test your skills[/p][/*][*][p]Real-time combat, exploration, and RPG elements[/p][/*][*][p][b]2 playable characters![/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts — share your experiences, feedback, and suggestions with us![/p]
